rows.constraints: Every entry is finite on every accepted call: the accumulation check rejects non-finite S, D or P; the stable final projection and finite gate prevent finite coefficients from producing an accepted NaN/Inf matrix. The small parallel component is preserved across near-resonant finite transverse/parallel scale separation instead of being erased by P-S cancellation. The specifically documented failures reject the whole call with a named exception rather than being evaluated -- a collapsed operand, a zero quotient, a collapsed field magnitude, a collapsed cyclotron term and a collapsed product of two non-zero operands (the four products the three Stix divisions consume) each raise ColdPlasmaOverflowError, and an exact collisionless resonance in a contributing species raises ColdPlasmaResonanceError. A zero-field point is not one of those failures and is returned isotropically. Those named paths are what this asset's evidence audits; other unguarded paths in the function are not ruled out, as verification.evidence_ceiling states. Hermitian at any field strength whenever no species contributes a collision, because i*D*[b]x is then purely imaginary and antisymmetric. A nonzero collision rate on a species that contributes does make it non-Hermitian; a nonzero collision rate on a species with zero density or zero charge does not. The entries are basis-dependent: b^H epsilon b equals P, but the axial entry equals P only when the field lies along that axis. A computed zero denominator is rechecked as an exact rational expression of represented omega, collision and cyclotron operands: a nonzero exact denominator raises ColdPlasmaOverflowError, rather than falsely claiming resonance. A confirmed pole, including a singular collective rational relation, raises ColdPlasmaResonanceError. The frequency still uses omega=2*pi_binary64*frequency_hz; no tolerance or physical convention is changed.
